headContext: The `== 0` comparison coerces `""` (empty string) and `[]` (empty array) to 0, so they now return false where `===` would have returned true for the `typeof` check. A logic-bug class.

groundTruth.note: The `== 0` loose equality coerces empty string/array to 0 — the `v === 0` strict comparison was the intended check.
